items.q: Virginia Maxie was there. ... supported by Clark Dennis and Virginia Maxie, vocalists.

ctx.x: Orchestra, in a garden setting, supported by Clark Dennis and Virginia Maxie, vocalists. Numbers, "Redskin Rhumba," "Skyliner," --
That's who that blond in that picture is, Virginia Maxie, yeah.
"Jeepers Creepers," "Peg o' My Heart," and, "Jealousy." So that's -- the band in the photograph is the band from "Redskin Rhumba." It says in a garden setting and --
